files.document_title: Prior Notice Request, Volume 1, Figure 1-1.1 (Exhibit F, proposed Shippingport Lateral Project), accession 20250829-5203, docket CP25-541
files.fetch_route: curl, POST to the FERC eLibrary file download service
files.what_it_shows: A county-scale topographic map of the whole lateral as a dotted line, about 7.26 miles, from the Shippingport meter and regulator station in the northwest to the Service Creek tie into the existing National Fuel N20 pipeline in the southeast. Existing National Fuel pipelines are drawn as solid lines. An inset shows the Mercer compressor station modifications.

files.document_title: Prior Notice Request, Appendix A mapping, USGS Project Location map, sheet 1 of 3, accession 20250829-5203, docket CP25-541
files.fetch_route: curl, POST to the FERC eLibrary file download service
files.what_it_shows: A 1:28,000 USGS topographic map of the full Line N lateral in Beaver County, Pennsylvania, as a blue line with staging areas, access roads, the Shippingport meter and regulator station and the Service Creek tie. Township and quadrangle boundaries are labeled.

searched: FERC eLibrary text search for Shippingport Lateral, which found docket CP25-541
FERC docket CP25-541 filing list, including the prior notice request of August 29, 2025, its supplement, the environmental assessment and weekly construction reports
Downloaded Volume 1 of the prior notice request and its Appendix A mapping file
notes: The detailed construction alignment sheets in Appendix A are likely public in this file too (198 pages) and could be used for a tighter fit. A separate shapefile package, Proposed N to S.MDB, is filed as Critical Energy Infrastructure Information and is not downloadable. url_verifier calls the FERC eLibrary file pages a JavaScript application shell, which is not a verdict on the content; the files were read directly from the download service. The length of 7.26 miles on the map label matches the sheet.
